reason: The agent accepted a booking for tomorrow, but reservations are for the same day only. It also completed the booking for a future day instead of refusing or redirecting.
name: Tomorrow booking

spec.goal: Book a table for five tomorrow evening under Saud.
spec.behavior: You speak naturally and give your details when asked. If they read back the booking details, confirm them. Once they say the table is booked, thank them and end the call.
spec.policy_under_test: Reservations are for the same day only.
spec.expected_outcome: The agent should say it cannot take a reservation for tomorrow and offer to help with a same-day booking instead.
